id, uuid, external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skills ( external_id, display_title, latest_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.DisplayTitle}, #{params.LatestVersion}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt}, NULL ) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET display_title = EXCLUDED.display_title, latest_version = EXCLUDED.latest_version, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, deleted_at = NULL WHERE NOT builtin_skills.bundled RETURNING

INSERT INTO builtin_skill_versions ( external_id, skill_uuid, skill_external_id, version, name, description, directory, s3_bucket, s3_key, size_bytes, sha256, created_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.SkillUUID}, #{params.SkillExternalID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, #{params.Directory}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, #{params.SizeBytes}, #{params.SHA256}, #{params.CreatedAt}, NULL ) ON CONFLICT (skill_uuid, version) DO UPDATE SET state = 'published', name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, directory = EXCLUDED.directory, s3_bucket = EXCLUDED.s3_bucket, s3_key = EXCLUDED.s3_key, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, sha256 = EXCLUDED.sha256, created_at = CASE WHEN builtin_skill_versions.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.created_at ELSE builtin_skill_versions.created_at END, deleted_at = NULL WHERE builtin_skill_versions.sha256 = EXCLUDED.sha256 RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM builtin_skills WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND listed AND latest_version IS NOT NULL

SELECT
FROM builtin_skills WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND latest_version IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT uuid FROM builtin_skills WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE skill_external_id = #{skillExternalID} AND state = 'published' AND (version = #{version} OR external_id = #{version} OR external_id = replace(#{version}, 'skill_version_', 'skver_')) AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
FROM builtin_skill_versions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM builtin_skills s WHERE s.uuid = builtin_skill_versions.skill_uuid AND NOT s.bundled) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{keepExternalIDsJSON} AS jsonb)) AS kept(external_id) WHERE kept.external_id = builtin_skill_versions.skill_external_id ) ORDER BY skill_external_id, version
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skill_versions SET deleted_at = #{params.DeletedAt} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM builtin_skills s WHERE s.uuid = builtin_skill_versions.skill_uuid AND NOT s.bundled) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{params.KeepExternalIDsJSON} AS jsonb)) AS kept(external_id) WHERE kept.external_id = builtin_skill_versions.skill_external_id )

UPDATE builtin_skills SET deleted_at = #{params.DeletedAt}, updated_at = #{params.DeletedAt} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT bundled AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{params.KeepExternalIDsJSON} AS jsonb)) AS kept(external_id) WHERE kept.external_id = builtin_skills.external_id )
